spec: §15 suite D (channel and unitary comparison for epsilon > 0 realisations); §8.3: a scheme's error is the sum of its template gates' charged errors; §12.3 inclusive error composition
derivation: With a target whose only rz realisation is a scheme of two template gates each charged epsilon 1/1000, the scheme-realised rz carries inclusive operator_norm error 2/1000 (sum over the template, §8.3), converting to diamond 4/1000 when first combined with a diamond value (§12.3). Checking a realised-vs-reference comparison at bound 1/500 must therefore accept on operator_norm and the same claim at bound 1/1000 must reject. Needs targeted scheduling (deliverables 9, 10) before the checker (11).

unavailable.reason: epsilon > 0 realisations need target descriptions (deliverable 9), the schedule consumer (10) and the rigorous checker (11); none has a reference-CLI surface
